Name: Desaturated East Scarp
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uniformly desaturates all [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] assets for a softer look and better compatibility with popular recolors. Every asset, from portraits to items to maps and more, is desaturated. Other mods that edit ES's assets will take priority over this one, so you can mix and match. Think of this mod as a catch-all for anything that isn't affected by another recolor mod. 

[b]Important![/b] This mod only desaturates assets that are included in the main East Scarp mod. East Scarp also uses HxW Tilesheets and Lumisteria Indoor and Outdoor Tilesheets. Desaturated versions of those mods are necessary if you want everything in East Scarp to be desaturated. You can find links to those here:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29737]Desaturated HxW Series[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39329]Desaturated Lumisteria Tilesheets[/url]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can turn desaturation on or off (default on) for individual characters' sprites/portraits, as well as for broad categories (like Furniture, Crops/forage, etc.).

Compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp[/url] is included. Note that you will need the original mod for the desaturated version to work.

Compatibility for add-on East Scarp mods like Rodney, Nora, Sen, etc. is not included in this mod.

This was specifically made to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/herbivoor?gameId=1303]Herbivoor[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] (significant preset). I recommend using both!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

You'll get a CMCT warning in your SMAPI log, but from my testing everything works fine.

Please let me know if you run into any other issues!
